evals.name: Measurement ID & Subdomain Data Stream Isolation
evals.prompt: Configure GA4 for a multi-service platform where app, tools, and marketing sites reside on separate subdomains without cross-traffic pollution.
evals.expected_output: Configures isolated Web Data Streams with dedicated G-XXXXXXXXXX IDs and loads gtag.js asynchronously.
assertions: Loads gtag.js asynchronously via official googletagmanager.com URL
Configures dedicated Measurement ID per subdomain without cross-stream pollution
Initializes global dataLayer array and gtag helper function safely
Uses valid GA4 Measurement ID syntax matching G-[A-Z0-9]+

evals.name: SPA Route Tracking & Duplicate Pageview Prevention
evals.prompt: Integrate GA4 in an Angular Single Page Application, preventing duplicate initial pageviews and capturing client-side route transitions.
evals.expected_output: Disables automatic page_view in initial config and dispatches page_view events on router navigation completion.
assertions: Configures send_page_view: false in initial gtag config call
Subscribes to router navigation events to track SPA view transitions
Dispatches explicit page_view event with page_path and page_title
Guards analytics service against server-side rendering execution

evals.name: Custom Event Taxonomy & PII Redaction
evals.prompt: Implement custom event tracking for user actions while enforcing snake_case naming conventions and strictly preventing PII transmission.
evals.expected_output: Emits valid custom events adhering to length and naming constraints while redacting passwords, emails, and sensitive tokens.
assertions: Enforces snake_case event names within 40-character length boundary
Strips passwords, auth tokens, and plaintext emails from event parameters
Wraps gtag calls with defensive runtime existence checks
